title: RNA Extraction from Peanut Samples Using Direct-zol™ RNA Miniprep
author: Gabriela S Paredes

steps.title: Prepare Buffers and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary kit buffers and enzymes before starting the extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add ethanol to the Direct-zol™ RNA PreWash concentrate and RNA Wash Buffer concentrate according to the kit instructions.
Reconstitute the lyophilized DNase I with DNase/RNase-Free Water as per the kit instructions.

steps.title: Homogenize Peanut Tissue
steps.instruction: Disrupt peanut tissues using a bead beater and TRIzol® or TRI Reagent® to ensure complete lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add the tissue sample and 2.0 mm beads to a suitable tube.
Add at least 800 µl of TRIzol® or TRI Reagent®.
Homogenize at high speed for 30-60 seconds.
Allow the sample to cool for 1-2 minutes.
Repeat homogenization for another 30-60 seconds.
If the lysate is viscous or precipitation is visible, add 100-200 µl additional TRIzol® and continue homogenizing until smooth and homogeneous (up to double the original volume if necessary).
Keep the sample at room temperature during processing to prevent premature nucleic acid precipitation.
Centrifuge the sample to remove particulate debris and transfer the supernatant to a new RNase-free tube.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Binding
steps.instruction: Adjust the homogenized sample to facilitate RNA binding to the column.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 95-100% ethanol to the homogenized sample (e.g., 400 µl ethanol for 400 µl sample).
Mix thoroughly by vortexing.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Load the sample onto the Zymo-Spin™ IICR Column to capture RNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mixture into a Zymo-Spin™ IICR Column in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000-16,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Discard the flow-through and place the column in a new collection tube.

steps.title: Perform DNase I Treatment (Optional)
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA from the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl of RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge.
Prepare DNase I mix in a separate RNase-free tube by adding 5 µl of DNase I (6 U/µl) to 75 µl of DNA Digestion Buffer; mix gently.
Add the DNase I mix directly to the column matrix.
Incubate at room temperature (20-30°C) for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash the RNA Column
steps.instruction: Remove residual reagents and contaminants from the column.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl of Direct-zol™ RNA PreWash to the column and centrifuge; discard flow-through.
Repeat the wash with another 400 µl of Direct-zol™ RNA PreWash.
Add 700 µl of RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new RNase-free tube.
Add 50 µl of DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix (or use a lower volume ≥ 25 µl for higher concentration).
Centrifuge to elute the RNA.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Verify the purity of the extracted RNA and store appropriately.

substeps.instruction: Assess RNA quality and quantity using a spectrophotometer (A260/A280 & A260/A230 ratios) and/or agarose gel electrophoresis.
Use the RNA immediately or store at -80°C for long-term storage.
